data.name: Ok
data.comment: A dialog's default button where its words say no more of what it does.

data.name: Cancel
data.comment: A dialog's or a popup's Cancel, which Escape clicks too.

data.name: DontAskAgain
data.comment: A question's check box beside its answers: ticked, the answer is kept in Settings and the question not asked again.

data.name: Close
data.comment: The tip of a tab's ×, which closes it.

data.name: GoToSource
data.comment: A list's row menu item going to where the row's code is written, which F4 does.

data.name: WithKeys
data.comment: A tip naming what a button or tab does and, after it, the keys that do the same (Step Over (F10)).

data.name: Refused
data.comment: A greyed button's tip: what it does, then why it cannot do it now (Delete: main is checked out).

data.name: KeysToFilter
data.comment: A tool window's filter field while it is empty: the keys that take it there (⌘F to filter).

data.name: Finder
data.comment: macOS's file manager, as the system names it in this language.

data.name: Explorer
data.comment: Windows' file manager (File Explorer), as the system names it in this language.

data.name: FileManager
data.comment: A Linux desktop's file manager, whichever it has.

data.name: ZoomIn
data.comment: A zoomed picture's button (a diagram, an image, the dependency map).

data.name: ActualSize
data.comment: A zoomed picture's button showing it at its own size.

data.name: FitZoom
data.comment: A zoomed picture's button fitting it whole in its place.

data.name: CopyName
data.comment: A list's row menu item copying the row's name.
